title: Run on Bedrock, Vertex, or custom provider
fullTitle: 0.13.6: Run on Bedrock, Vertex, or custom provider
description: Conductor 0.13.6 changelog - Run on Bedrock, Vertex, or custom provider
summary: You can now set up Claude Code to run via an alternate provider, like Bedrock, Vertex, or any Anthropic compatible URL.
html:
You can now set up Claude Code to run via an alternate provider, like Bedrock, Vertex, or any Anthropic compatible URL.

Fixes

  • More reliable auto-updater
  • Fixed width of "Open In" buttons
  • Added privacy link to onboarding
  • Added some tips on using Conductor with Cursor and VS Code.
markdown: You can now set up Claude Code to run via an alternate provider, like Bedrock, Vertex, or any Anthropic compatible URL. ## Fixes - More reliable auto-updater - Fixed width of "Open In" buttons - Added privacy link to onboarding - Added some tips on using [Conductor with Cursor and VS Code](/docs/guides/migrate-from-cursor#open-workspaces-in-cursor-or-vs-code).
